title: Report for disconnected mobile numbers (NSE UCI)
purpose: The firm's client codes whose mobile numbers are on DoT's Mobile Number Revocation List (MNRL), from NSE's UCI Member Portal > Download > Report for disconnected Mobile numbers. NSE does not publish the file's columns: they are read by their header names, which this layout lists (add a header text here when NSE's differs).
linked: Matched with the clients on Clients & onboarding → Revoked mobiles: each match flags the client, holds SMS and WhatsApp to the number and asks an Ops maker to confirm the client's number.
source: NSE/ISC/72805 (13 Feb 2026): the report is posted daily at UCI Member Portal > Download > Report for disconnected Mobile numbers; NSE/ISC/47834 (31 Mar 2021): it lists the member's client codes whose mobile numbers are on the MNRL. Neither gives the columns, so they are read by header names.
